svg.title: How a Session reaches git, integrations and other Repos
svg.desc: Operator choices become sandbox rules. The agent runs commands and file tools open to every folder and host except the Keychain, ~/.ops-console, git control files and a read-only run's working folder, and asks console tools to open pull requests and for run_integration, the one door out to the integration CLIs.
svg.text: How a Session reaches git, integrations and other Repos
macOS Seatbelt · every Access mode · the run fails if it is unavailable
CONSOLE TOOLS · the agent asks, the daemon acts as you, outside the sandbox
integration writes · save_file · spawn_sessions · PROD writes
a no is final · Don't ask again this Session: one CLI's writes
console fetches the default branch before each run
sandbox closes Keychain, ~/.ops-console, git control files
file-tool denials · system prompt · opened Repos, operator runs
the one door to your CLIs
cannot read the Keychain or ~/.ops-console and writes no git control file. Everything else is open to it. The console does the rest.
git switch · add · commit · build · test · servers · Docker
commit hooks run here · --no-verify refused · git push is not blocked
any host, any localhost port, any Unix socket
no read of the Keychain folder or ~/.ops-console
no edit of the git control files
admin-panel and any other you ticked
git control files closed in each
hooks, config, config.worktree, commondir, gitdir · a worktree's .git file
a read-only run's working folder: a review of pull request text, a thread answer
any host · any localhost port · any Unix socket
